public_rationale: There is evidence of AI-related market punishment, including sharp declines at infrastructure providers. The IMF also identifies a correction driven by disappointing AI returns as a risk. The admissible records do not establish the broader downturn and causal connection required for a conclusive event. Reports of a larger South Korean decline remain an important access gap. With no deadline, continued survival or growth cannot settle the forecast against Zitron.
limitations: A narrower reading of reckoning as any substantial repricing could change the result.
Several potentially important reports were inaccessible through the required reader.
Warnings about future losses cannot substitute for realized outcomes.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The author believes that at some point things have to collapse and that the generative AI boom is the force that creates a reckoning in the tech industry, though he is not saying every major tech company goes belly-up.
conditions: not saying that every major tech company goes belly-up

statement.excerpt: At some point, things have to collapse. I am not saying that every major tech company goes belly-up, but I believe the generative AI boom is the force that creates a reckoning in this industry.

from_speaker: not saying that every major tech company goes belly-up
the generative AI boom is the force
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a substantial technology-industry downturn materially caused by disappointing returns from the generative AI boom.
The surrounding discussion links the reckoning to poor business returns and market punishment. Universal bankruptcy is explicitly excluded.
I believe expresses confidence, and the bankruptcy qualification limits scope; neither is a conditional antecedent.
A short selloff or a warning of future losses does not by itself establish the industry reckoning.
criteria.support_condition: A substantial industry downturn occurs, and reliable evidence identifies failed or disappointing generative AI investment as a material cause.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period of continued growth can conclusively contradict this undated eventual forecast.
